LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_CiAnBiAn.label: (Raven) Cian Bian Blades
LanguageData.Raven_Weapon_CiAnBiAn.description: A bizarre pair of twin blades forged from interlaced Raven Darkfeather Steel and Raven Corona Steel. When sheathed, they hang by the side like exquisite ornaments; but the moment they are drawn, the twin blades constantly shift between reality and illusion, weaving a dazzling purplish-red web of lethal strikes that tear enemies to shreds.
